message: 必要な物と人
Suddenly, my left hand was grabbed tightly.

name: Azel
message: 「Come.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whoa, so passionate first thing in the morning! You've gotta step up your game too, Nana-chan!」
Dragged out into the hallway

name: Synn
message: 「Did you run out of storage space or something?」

name: Azel
message: 「Yes. I used up all the film, so transfer it for me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Film?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hooold it right there, you two! Homeroom starts in two minutes!」

name: Azel
message: 「Be quiet. It's an emergency.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's no excuse to skip homeroom!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sigh, you're totally hopeless, Nana-chan.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What was that?!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「In a situation like this, you have to compete with Azel-chan by grabbing Synn-kun's right hand and pulling him back!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I see!」

name: Azel
message: 「No. I am taking this man with me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like hell you are!」
My right hand was grabbed with a firm grip.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Now, let the battle of the women begin! Split left and right, heigh-ho, heigh-ho!」
I somehow feel completely mortified

name: Sacchin
message: 「And then! Whichever one feels sorry for Synn-kun being in pain and lets go first is the real mother!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm not trying to become Synn's mom or anything!」

name: Azel
message: 「I will pass as well.」

name: Synn
message: 「The mom I already have is more than enough for me.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Damn straight.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, before the battle starts, there's one thing I want to ask Azel, though」

name: Azel
message: 「What is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「What you used up was film, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「That's why I said to transfer it」

name: Synn
message: 「You can't transfer film to a computer, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「You have to get it developed at a photo shop, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「O-Of course I know that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-Is this!? Knowing Synn's personality, a really bad turn of events!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Azel, you still don't know your way around Ryuusei Town well, right? Once Student Council activities are over, I'll take you to the photo shop!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, nice suggestion~」

name: Synn
message: 「No way, Nanaka. You have patrol today, don't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「I know! Azel, once Student Council activities are over, let's go to the photo shop together!」

name: Synn
message: 「And hey, I saved up enough shopping district points, so on the way back I'll treat you to that ramen I promised」

name: Azel
message: 「Ramen! Understood! By all means, take me with you!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Auu...... Worst possible outcome」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, what's been wrong with you for a while now?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「IT'S NOTHING AT ALL」

name: Paqy
message: 「How pitiful」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That totally backfired on you, huh~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up! Take this, Sacchin!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「No, not the pickled plum face~ It totally backfired on me~」

name: Azel
message: 「Synn Sakura」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm?」

name: Azel
message: 「The day after tomorrow... is Sunday, isn't it」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, it is」

name: Azel
message: 「Could it not come a little sooner?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, that's impossible」

name: Azel
message: 「True. Even I know that is unreasonable」

name: Azel
message: 「Still... I wish Sunday would get here faster...」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you really that excited for the photos to be ready?」
Azel started to deny it, swallowed her words, and

name: Azel
message: 「Yes. I am excited」

name: Synn
message: 「Hope we got some good shots」

name: Azel
message: 「I do not know about that, but... I am looking forward to it」

name: Azel
message: 「I think I will be excited the whole time from now until Sunday」
She wouldn't say something like that if she were just taking photos for an investigation.
Azel really does love photography.

name: Synn
message: 「Once they're ready, we'll have to go show Melilot-san」

name: Azel
message: 「That goes without saying. However, I will show them to you before anyone else」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see」
There's probably no deeper meaning to it.
It just means she'll meet up with me before going to see Melilot-san.

name: Synn
message: 「You've really come to love photography, haven't you, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「Yes. I love it. I am glad I came to love it. It makes me feel this excited」
Azel smiled earnestly.
She really is a cute girl after all.

name: Azel
message: 「Synn Sakura. It is all thanks to you」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
My hand was squeezed tight.

name: Synn
message: 「A-Azel.」
It was a small hand, and a little cold. Even so, it felt comfortable and ticklish.

name: Azel
message: 「I have been meaning to tell you this for a long time.」
Her clear eyes look straight up at me.
I feel like I could get drawn right into them.

name: Azel
message: 「Even though I treated you so harshly, you kept reaching out to me, and because of that, I discovered the library, photo books, and cameras.」

name: Azel
message: 「I even became friends with Melilot, and she lent me a digital camera.」

name: Synn
message: 「You would've found all that even without me.」

name: Azel
message: 「That is not true.」

name: Synn
message: 「What I did wasn't really a big deal.」

name: Azel
message: 「To you, it may not have been a big deal. However--」

name: Azel
message: 「To me, it was a very big deal.」
With one thing leading to another, we also went to eat ramen.
The walk to the dorm as I saw Azel home felt terribly short.

name: Azel
message: 「This is... perhaps a bit late to be saying, but--」

name: Synn
message: 「What?」

name: Azel
message: 「Thank you... for walking me home today as well.」
You're being awfully honest today.
Even I know that saying that out loud would be poking a hornet's nest.

name: Synn
message: 「No problem. I just can't leave you alone, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「I am not the sort of person you need to worry about. You are far more reckless than I am.」

name: Synn
message: 「You think so...?」

name: Azel
message: 「I do. You ought to reflect on your actions a little.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... Nothing really comes to mind.」
Azel gave a small laugh.

name: Azel
message: 「You are always looking forward, so I suppose you have no time to reflect on the past.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, even I reflect on things sometimes.」

name: Azel
message: 「Did you not just say nothing came to mind?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right」
Suddenly, the conversation trails off.
Azel has to go back to the dorm, and I have to go home.
Still, just a little longer.
For some reason, feeling that way,

name: Synn
message: 「By the way, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「What is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... have you decided on a new place yet?」

name: Azel
message: 「I haven't heard anything from Helena yet」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Still, you should get ready for the move」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm already done」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll help you out on the day of」

name: Azel
message: 「Thank you... though I don't have enough luggage to need help」

name: Synn
message: 「What about furniture and stuff?」

name: Azel
message: 「Nothing at all. My only personal belongings are this Leica and my clothes」

name: Synn
message: 「Those clothes. You really treasure them, huh」

name: Azel
message: 「That's not it. It would just be a waste otherwise」

name: Synn
message: 「...Really?」

name: Azel
message: 「Really! It's not because they're cute or anything like that!」
It seemed she liked them because they were cute.

name: Azel
message: 「Stop grinning!」

name: Synn
message: 「Once you move, you should at least buy a refrigerator」

name: Azel
message: 「A refrigerator?」

name: Azel
message: 「O-Of course I know what that is」

name: Synn
message: 「If there's anything you want to buy, I'll show you around the shopping district」

name: Azel
message: 「Thank you... I'll take you up on that when the time comes」
